info.title: Sponzey Fleet Controller API
info.summary: REST API for the Sponzey Fleet controller.
info.description: Sponzey Fleet exposes controller APIs for agent enrollment, inventory, job dispatch, snapshots, drift reports, and audit events. HTTP transport is supported only for local or short-lived tests. Use HTTPS for product, production, shared, or long-running environments because HTTP does not provide confidentiality or integrity.

bearerAuth.description: Paste the admin token printed by `sponzey controller init`. Do not use real tokens in examples or logs.

required_permission.description: Present on forbidden responses to name the permission that the authenticated admin actor lacks.

persisted_record_present.description: False when no rotation record has been created and the controller is treated as active steady.

active_signing_fingerprint_prefix.description: Prefix of the active runtime signing fingerprint; never a public key body.

selected_signing_fingerprint_prefix.description: Prefix of the domain-selected signing fingerprint; never a public key body.

bootstrap_guard.description: Summary of whether the active runtime key matches the domain-selected key.

agent_trust_rollout.description: Readiness summary for agent trust-bundle rollout.

ControllerSigningRotationRestartPlanResp.description: Read-only operator guidance for controller signing rotation restart/reload verification. This response never performs restart, reload, key swap, runtime config patching, or secret material exposure.

restart_required.description: True when active runtime signer does not match the persisted selected signing key.

reload_supported.description: False until an audited hot reload action is explicitly implemented.

blocked_reason.example: active signer does not match persisted selected signer; restart controller with validated signing material and verify status before retiring old key

example: this version does not support in-process controller signing key reload
restart the controller process through the service manager after validated material is in place
verify bootstrap_guard is active_matches_selected before retiring the old key

ControllerSigningRotationRestartActionBo.description: Record an audited external controller restart intent. The controller API does not self-restart, reload key files, or mutate runtime config.

confirm_external_restart.description: Must be true to confirm the operator will restart the controller through an external service manager.

reason.description: Optional operator reason. Secret-like markers are redacted before audit storage.

ControllerSigningRotationRestartActionRe.description: Secret-free audit result for an external controller restart action. This response never includes key paths, key bodies, TLS material, task payloads, or process environment values.

example: controller restart is executed outside the HTTP handler through an explicit service-manager command
this action records operator intent only and does not reload keys or mutate runtime config
after service restart, verify bootstrap_guard is active_matches_selected

ControllerSigningRotationRequestBody.description: Request a controller signing rotation using public fingerprint metadata only. Raw key bodies, PEM bodies, TLS certificate material, task payload bodies, and process environment values are not accepted.

new_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the candidate controller signing public key.

old_key_verifies_for_seconds.description: Relative verification window for the old signing key. Provide exactly one of this field or old_key_verifies_until_ms.

old_key_verifies_until_ms.description: Absolute old-key verification expiry in Unix epoch milliseconds. Provide exactly one of this field or old_key_verifies_for_seconds.

ControllerSigningRotationValidateBody.description: Validate candidate controller signing material using explicit file paths on the controller host. The API does not accept key bodies.

candidate_public_key_path.description: Controller-local candidate public key file path.

candidate_private_key_path.description: Controller-local candidate private key file path. The response never echoes this value.

reason.example: candidate keypair validated on controller host

ControllerSigningTrustBundleRolloutBody.description: Dispatch a public-only controller signing trust bundle update to authenticated connected agent sessions. Private key material, key bodies, TLS material, task payloads, and process environment values are not accepted.

previous_public_key_path.description: Controller-local public key file path for the previous signing key during dual-trust rollout. The path is not returned or logged.

agent_ids.description: Optional target agent ids. When omitted or empty, all authenticated connected sessions are targeted.

max_agent_count.description: Optional bounded batch limit for rollout/retry dispatch. Omit to attempt every selected target; zero is rejected.

ControllerSigningTrustBundleStagedRollou.description: Run one explicit staged controller signing trust bundle coordinator tick. The request supplies the rollout controls; no hidden global defaults, runtime environment changes, private key material, key bodies, TLS material, task payloads, or process environment values are accepted.

previous_public_key_path.description: Controller-local public key file path for the previous signing key during dual-trust rollout. The path is used only to build the public-only trust bundle and is not returned or logged.

agent_ids.description: Optional target agent ids. When omitted or empty, the tick targets the currently authenticated connected sessions observed in the session registry.

batch_size.description: Maximum number of non-current connected agents the domain staged rollout planner may dispatch in this tick.

max_failures.description: Maximum failed target count the staged rollout state machine may tolerate before failing the rollout.

ack_timeout_seconds.description: Acknowledgement timeout used by the staged rollout state machine for dispatched batches.

token.description: Sensitive raw enrollment token. It is returned once immediately after creation and is not stored in plaintext.

connected.description: True when the controller currently has an authenticated persistent session for this agent.

assigned_policy_ids.description: Policy ids directly assigned to this agent.

capabilities.description: Latest agent-reported capability names stored by the controller. Dispatch decisions are still made by the controller/application layer, not by clients.

capability_reported_at_ms.description: Agent system time when the latest capability snapshot was reported. Null when no capability snapshot has been stored yet.

AgentCertificateIssuanceRequestResponse.description: Result of requesting agent client certificate issuance. Dispatch status means the controller queued a public lifecycle update to an authenticated session; it does not mean the agent accepted or installed certificate material.

AgentCertificateLifecycleStatusResponse.description: Read-only public agent client certificate lifecycle status. This response does not include certificate bodies, private keys, certificate file paths, CA paths, runtime environment values, or WebSocket handles.

record_present.description: False when the agent exists but no lifecycle record has been created yet.

agent_system_time_ms.description: System time reported by the agent when it produced this snapshot.

source.description: Policy document source. The controller validates it before storing.
source.example:
apiVersion: fleet.sponzey.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: nginx-running
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      role: web
  checks:
    - id: nginx-service
      service:
        name: nginx
        state: running

runbook_document.description: Canonical v1alpha1 runbook YAML. If request target_agent_ids, selector, and matchLabels are all empty, the controller resolves targets from the selector or matchLabels inside this document. Supported safe primitives include port.check, process.check, facts.collect, and metrics.snapshot. Controlled mutation primitives include package, service, and file.copy.
runbook_document.example:
apiVersion: fleet.sponzey.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Runbook
name: nginx-basic
description: Install nginx and verify the local listener.
matchLabels:
  role: web
strategy:
  concurrency: 1
  maxFailures: 1
checkMode: false
dryRun: false
steps:
  - id: nginx-package
    package:
      name: nginx
      state: present
  - id: http-listener
    port.check:
      host: 127.0.0.1
      port: 8080

policy_document.example:
apiVersion: fleet.sponzey.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: nginx-running
spec:
  targets:
    selector: role=web
  checks: []

concurrency.description: Maximum number of assignments dispatched concurrently for one job. Omit for sequential fanout.

maxFailures.description: When this many assignment failures are reached, remaining queued assignments are canceled. Omit to keep dispatching queued targets.

selector.description: String selector. Supported forms are agent:<name-or-id>, label:key=value, or key=value[,key=value]. Cannot be combined with matchLabels.

matchLabels.description: Object label selector. All labels must match. Cannot be combined with selector.

message.example: 1 disabled or revoked agent(s) match the selector but will be excluded

selected_for_dispatch.description: False for disabled or revoked matches that are intentionally excluded from dispatch.

status.description: Initial job status. Approval-gated jobs return pending_approval.

approval_request_id.description: Approval request id when the job is pending approval. Null when the job is queued immediately.

reason.description: Creation reason for pending approvals, or approver decision reason for terminal approvals.

ApprovalDecisionRequest.description: Approval decision payload. The authenticated admin token determines the approver actor; the legacy actor field is accepted for compatibility but ignored.

actor.description: Deprecated compatibility field. The controller ignores this value and uses the authenticated admin actor.

RemediationRequestResponse.description: Remediation metadata only. Raw runbook documents, rendered bodies, command output, tokens, and secrets are not returned by remediation metadata endpoints.

approval_id.description: Optional deterministic id for tests or external automation. Omit to let the controller generate one.

job_id.description: Optional reserved remediation job id. The job row is created only after approval.

runbook_document.description: Approved runbook source used to create the signed remediation job. The raw document is accepted in the request only and is not returned by remediation responses.

status.description: Success moves the remediation to succeeded_pending_verify. Failure moves it to failed.

cancel_delivered.description: True when the controller enqueued a task_cancel message to an active agent session. The database cancel state remains the source of truth even when this is false.

canceled_count.description: Number of queued, dispatched, accepted, or started assignments marked canceled by this request.

cancel_delivered_count.description: Number of active agent sessions that received a task_cancel message.

JobStatus.description: Domain job aggregate state. A single-agent job is treated as a multi-agent job with one assignment.

AssignmentStatus.description: Per-agent task assignment state. This is distinct from target agent connectivity status; output_received is an event, not an assignment state.

RenderedArtifactMetadataResponse.description: Rendered artifact metadata only. The job summary does not include rendered body, local filesystem path, or destination path.

dispatch_state.description: Operator-facing dispatch state derived by the controller. It does not contain raw command output.

selector_kind.description: How the job target set was resolved: explicit_ids, selector, matchLabels, or resolved_ids.

selector_source.description: The original selector source persisted when the job was created.

rendered_artifacts.description: Rendered artifact metadata for this job. Body bytes are available only through the artifact retrieval endpoint.

target_connected.description: True when at least one target currently has an authenticated persistent session.

last_error.description: Controller-visible dispatch or terminal error summary. Raw stdout/stderr is only available through the output API.

skipped.description: Assignments canceled before dispatch because maxFailures was reached.

unknown.description: Targets whose assignment status is absent or not recognized.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of assignments the controller may dispatch concurrently for this job.

maxFailures.description: Failure threshold that cancels remaining queued assignments. Null means no threshold.

status.description: Operator-facing status derived from the target snapshot and current controller connection state.

snapshot_status.description: Agent status captured when the job target snapshot was created.

labels.description: Agent labels captured when the job target snapshot was created.

task_id.description: Task assignment id for this target. Null when no assignment exists in legacy or incomplete summaries.

assignment_status.description: Per-target assignment state. This is distinct from target connectivity status.

last_error.description: Redacted per-target assignment error summary. Raw stdout/stderr is only available through the output API.

retention_class.description: Artifact retention class recorded with the metadata.

checksum_sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 checksum verified before the body is returned.

size_bytes.description: Stored artifact byte size from metadata.

content_bytes.description: Verified artifact content bytes. The response never includes the local filesystem path.

value.description: Redacted value. SecretRef values are exposed only as the marker 'secret_ref'.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for requesting the next older page.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to pass as the next request's before query. Null means no next page.

Unauthorized.description: Admin token is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: The admin token is valid, but the authenticated admin actor does not have the required permission.

NotFound.description: The requested record was not found.

BadRequest.description: The request body or path parameter was invalid.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with an existing record or state.

Return the OpenAPI 3.1 document.

Read the controller signing identity.

200.description: Controller public identity and TLS metadata.

get.summary: Read controller signing rotation readiness status.
get.description: Admin-only read-only endpoint. Returns persisted rotation state, readiness, fingerprint prefixes, and dual-trust timing without private key material, key paths, TLS certificate material, raw public key bodies, or task payload bodies.

200.description: Secret-free controller signing rotation readiness status.

get.summary: Read controller signing rotation restart/reload operator plan.
get.description: Admin-only read-only endpoint. Returns restart-required guidance, verification commands, and safety notes derived from status. It does not restart the controller, reload key files, swap signing material, patch runtime config, or expose key paths/material.

200.description: Secret-free controller signing rotation restart plan.

post.summary: Record audited external restart intent for controller signing rotation.
post.description: Admin-only mutation endpoint. Requires explicit confirmation, writes a security audit event, and returns external service-manager restart guidance. It does not self-restart the HTTP handler, invoke systemd, reload key files, swap signing material, patch runtime config, or expose key paths/material.

200.description: Secret-free audited external restart action response.

post.description: Admin-only mutation endpoint. Creates a rotation_requested state using public fingerprints and an old-key verification window. Raw key bodies, PEM bodies, TLS certificate material, task payload bodies, and process environment values are not accepted.

200.description: Secret-free rotation readiness after the mutation.

post.description: Admin-only mutation endpoint. Validates candidate signing material using explicit controller-local file paths, then records new_material_validated. It does not accept or return key bodies.

example.reason: candidate keypair validated on controller host

200.description: Secret-free rotation readiness after the mutation.

post.summary: Activate dual trust for controller signing rotation.
post.description: Admin-only mutation endpoint. Transitions validated rotation state to dual_trust_active. It does not implicitly read or swap key material.

200.description: Secret-free rotation readiness after the mutation.

post.summary: Retire the old controller signing key.
post.description: Admin-only mutation endpoint. Retires the old signing key only after the domain old-key verification window guard allows it.

200.description: Secret-free rotation readiness after the mutation.

post.description: Admin-only mutation endpoint. Records a terminal failed state with redacted reason handling. Secret-like reason content is not returned or stored in the rotation state.

200.description: Secret-free rotation readiness after the mutation.

post.summary: Roll out controller signing trust bundle to connected agents.
post.description: Admin-only mutation endpoint. Builds a public-only controller_signing_trust_bundle_update payload from active runtime signing identity and persisted rotation state, then sends it to authenticated connected sessions. Agents answer with public-only controller_signing_trust_bundle_ack; already-current acknowledged sessions are reported as skipped_already_current. It does not include private key material, create Job/Assignment state, or treat delivery as task acceptance.

post.summary: Run one staged controller signing trust bundle rollout coordinator tick.
post.description: Admin-only mutation endpoint. Converts active session registry connection and public-only acknowledgement state into domain staged rollout observations, asks the domain state machine for one bounded batch, and dispatches a public-only controller_signing_trust_bundle_update payload. This is a synchronous coordinator tick; it does not create a background scheduler, persist scheduler continuity, create Job/Assignment state, store WebSocket handles in domain/storage, or treat delivery as task acceptance.

post.summary: Retry controller signing trust bundle rollout with an explicit batch limit.
post.description: Admin-only mutation endpoint. Reuses the public-only trust bundle construction boundary and attempts a bounded retry against selected authenticated connected sessions. It uses observable session registry state and public-only ack state only and does not infer hidden key paths, store WebSocket handles, create Job/Assignment state, or treat delivery as task acceptance.

post.summary: Enroll an agent with an enrollment token.
post.description: This endpoint does not use the admin bearer token. The one-time enrollment token is provided in the request body.

get.summary: List enrollment token summaries.

post.description: The raw token is returned only once. Store it securely and do not log it.

get.summary: List known agents.
Get one agent.
Get public agent client certificate lifecycle status.
get.description: Returns stored public lifecycle state for a known agent. If the agent exists but no lifecycle record exists, the response is `not_issued` with `record_present=false`. This endpoint is read-only and does not inspect runtime WebSocket ack state.

post.description: Creates or updates the public agent certificate lifecycle state through the application use case, writes Security audit, and attempts to dispatch a public-only lifecycle update to the connected authenticated agent session. This endpoint does not issue certificate material, install certificates, mutate runtime configuration, or enforce listener mTLS.

202.description: Issuance request persisted. Dispatch status is observational only.

post.description: Disables the current agent key. The agent is shown as offline and revoked and must be enrolled again with a new enrollment token.

get.description: Returns newest product-safe agent operational log chunks first. This stream is separate from command stdout/stderr, which is exposed through the job output API.

200.description: Latest drift report, or null when none exists.

get.summary: List drift reports for an agent.
get.description: Returns newest reports first. Use `limit` and pass the previous response `next_cursor` as `before` to fetch the next page.

post.description: Marks queued, dispatched, accepted, or started assignments as canceled. If the target agent has an active session, the controller also sends a task_cancel message. HTTP transport is test-only; use HTTPS for product or production environments.

post.summary: Preview selector targets before creating a job.
post.description: Uses the same selector resolution policy as job creation. Disabled or revoked agents are shown as matches but excluded from dispatch targets. Offline agents can be selected and remain queued until they reconnect.

Create a signed command job. Safe single-target commands queue immediately. High-risk commands and broad-target jobs return pending_approval with an approval_request_id and are not dispatched until approved.
Create a signed runbook job. Runbook execution is high risk and returns pending_approval with an approval_request_id until approved.

get.summary: List approval requests.
get.description: List approval requests, optionally filtered by status. Web Admin approval queue should use status=pending.

post.description: Moves the approval to approved, changes the linked job to queued, writes audit, and dispatches queued assignments when an authenticated agent session is available.
Moves the approval to rejected, changes the linked job to failed, and writes audit.
Expires pending approval requests whose expiry time has passed and changes linked jobs to expired.

get.summary: List remediation requests.
get.description: Returns remediation metadata only. Raw runbook bodies, rendered artifacts, command output, tokens, and secrets are not returned.

get.summary: Get remediation request metadata.
get.description: Returns one remediation metadata record without raw runbook bodies, rendered artifacts, command output, tokens, or secrets.

post.description: Moves a proposed remediation to pending_approval and stores an approval request for a reserved remediation job id. No job or task assignment is created by this endpoint.

post.summary: Approve remediation and create a signed runbook job.
post.description: Approves the linked approval request, creates a queued signed runbook job for the remediation target snapshot, stores task assignment metadata, writes audit events, and dispatches only after store persistence when an active authenticated agent session exists.
Moves a job_created remediation to running after the linked job starts. The request must provide the matching job id.
Records the linked remediation job result. Success moves the remediation to succeeded_pending_verify; it does not mark drift resolved until verification evidence matches.
Marks remediation resolved only when agent id, policy id, policy name, job id, and latest drift evidence match. Mismatched evidence is rejected.

get.summary: List stored output chunks for a job.
Get a verified rendered artifact body.
get.description: Looks up rendered artifact metadata by job id and artifact id, verifies the ArtifactStore checksum, and returns bytes without exposing local filesystem paths.

get.summary: List recent audit events.
Export audit events with cursor paging.
get.description: Returns audit events in newest-first order. Optional category filters to one audit category. SecretRef values are not exposed; they are returned as the marker 'secret_ref'. No audit update or delete API is exposed.
